name: Bookmarks' dialogs follow the theme through the kit: in Dark, Light, Apple TV and Purple Haze the editor's surface is the theme's native dialog colour, its text the page's, its inputs the theme's emby-input colours and its primary button the theme's accent (Purple Haze #48c3c8), never the MUI surface or text variables; and Bookmarks' settings page on the dashboard follows the dashboard theme (Dark by default) while the user theme is Apple TV. The theme is chosen per browser through localStorage['<userId>-appTheme']; each run has a fresh browser profile, so it starts on Dark and needs no restore.

steps.name: find Long Test Movie
steps.eval: (await ApiClient.getItems(ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(), { IncludeItemTypes: 'Movie', Recursive: true, SearchTerm: 'Long Test Movie', Limit: 1 })).Items[0].Id

steps.name: choose Purple Haze for this browser
choose Apple TV for this browser
Bookmarks' settings page on the dashboard (user theme Apple TV)
the settings form and its Diagnostics section
dashboard colours
steps.eval: (() => { const page = document.querySelector('#BookmarksConfigPage:not(.hide)'); const cs = (el, p) => getComputedStyle(el).getPropertyValue(p).trim(); return { theme: document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme'), userTheme: localStorage.getItem(ApiClient.getCurrentUserId() + '-appTheme'), htmlColor: cs(document.documentElement, 'color'), pageColor: cs(page, 'color'), diagnosticsColor: cs(document.querySelector('#BookmarksDiagnosticsSummary'), 'color'), saveBackground: cs(page.querySelector('#BookmarksConfigForm .button-submit'), 'background-color') }; })()

steps.name: in every theme the editor's surface, text, inputs and note textarea (since 1.1) are the theme's own
steps.assert: [__vars.dark, __vars.light, __vars.appletv, __vars.purplehaze].every(t => t.panelBackground === t.nativeDialogBackground && t.panelColor === t.htmlColor && t.inputBackground === t.nativeInputBackground && t.textareaBackground === t.nativeInputBackground)
